functions.body:
select p.role from public.profiles as p
  where p.id = auth.uid() and p.active is true

-- Only orders that reserve capacity count, per state_reserves_capacity() above, which
  -- is the engine's RESERVING list. A cancelled or no-show order releases its boxes.
  --
  -- The check has to happen inside the insert transaction, not before it: checking and
  -- then inserting is a race, and the race is two customers taking the last box. See
  -- src/lib/rules/capacity.ts and tests/fixtures/capacity-cases.json.
  select greatest(
    0,
    coalesce((select capacity from drops where id = p_drop_id), 0)
      - coalesce((
          select sum(oi.qty)::int
          from orders o
          join order_items oi on oi.order_id = o.id
          where o.drop_id = p_drop_id
            and state_reserves_capacity(o.state)
        ), 0)
  );
select coalesce(current_role_name() = 'owner', false)
select current_role_name() is not null

select o.id, o.customer_name, o.state, o.pay_state, o.total_cents, d.pickup_at, o.placed_at
  from orders o left join drops d on d.id = o.drop_id
  where o.id = p_order_id
    and regexp_replace(o.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = regexp_replace(p_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
  limit 1

with defaults (key, int_value, text_value, cents_value) as (
    values
      ('capacity', 200, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('taxRate', 3, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('drawerFloat', null::bigint, null::text, 100000),
      ('discountA', 20, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('discountB', 50, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('restHours', 24, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('doughWarnDays', 14, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('groceryBudget', null::bigint, null::text, 600000),
      ('packagingFee', null::bigint, null::text, 3844),
      ('flatBoxPrice', null::bigint, null::text, 86000),
      ('cogsMultiple', 4, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('priceMode', null::bigint, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('openDow', 1, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('openH', 9, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('openM', 0, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('closeDow', 4, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('closeH', 21, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('closeM', 0, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('extendH', 0, null::text, null::bigint),
      ('retention', null::bigint, '1 year', null::bigint),
      ('maxPerOrder', 24, null::text, null::bigint)
  )
  select d.key,
         coalesce(s.int_value,   d.int_value),
         coalesce(s.text_value,  d.text_value),
         coalesce(s.cents_value, d.cents_value),
         s.key is null
    from defaults d
    left join settings s on s.key = d.key;
select p_state in ('Confirmed', 'Preparing', 'Ready', 'Completed', 'No-show');
select p_state in ('Confirmed', 'Preparing');

begin
  if not is_staff() then
    raise exception 'only staff may change an order';
  end if;

  return query
    update orders o
       set state     = coalesce(p_state, o.state),
           pay_state = coalesce(p_pay_state, o.pay_state),
           pay_ref   = coalesce(p_pay_ref, o.pay_ref)
     where o.id = p_order_id
       -- The guard. Millisecond equality is exact here: updated_at is set by the trigger,
       -- never by a client, so the value the caller read is the value in the row.
       and o.updated_at = p_seen_at
    returning o.id, o.state, o.pay_state, o.updated_at;
end;
